svg.title: A boundary-scan (JTAG) chain
svg.desc: Block diagram, not to scale. A six-pin connector J1 carries TCK, TMS, TRST, TDI, TDO and ground. TDI from the connector goes into the first chip, U1; U1's TDO goes into U2's TDI; U2's TDO into U3's TDI; and U3's TDO back to the connector, making one chain. TCK, TMS and TRST run to all three chips in parallel. TMS and TDI have pull-up resistors and TRST a pull-down, as the chip makers advise. A memory chip next to U1 doesn't support boundary scan, but its connections to U1 can still be tested through U1's pins.

g.text: Chain: TDI → each chip → TDO, back to J1
TCK, TMS, TRST: shared by every chip
Ordinary connections, tested through U1's pins
Resistor values and TCK termination: follow each chip maker's guidance.
Ground sits beside the signals in J1.
